period_note: CONSOLIDATED (Group) basis, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series (see sources.json reporting_basis). Source: Southeast Bank's own BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' disclosure table, embedded in its annual report (a corporate-governance disclosure most banks answer with a checkbox, but which Southeast Bank answers with an actual Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet-and-income-statement table for that report's own year, plus a comparative column for the prior year). Balance-sheet line items are the 1 January to 30 September 2021 period-end snapshot (basis reported). Income-statement line items and EPS are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2021 ("1 January to 30 September 2021" exactly as the table's own column header states), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, basis reported, same convention as CITYBANK. Balance-sheet identity (Total assets = Total liabilities + Total equity + Non-controlling interest) holds to within BDT 1m rounding. Cumulative net profit after tax increases monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 within 2021 (validated; no violation). Cross-checked against the FY2022 report's comparative column: Q1, Q2 and Q3 balance-sheet and net-profit figures all match exactly (to within BDT 1m rounding). Only the Q4/year-end column differs between the two reports (Total Liabilities 465,498m in the FY2021 report's own table vs 465,844m in the FY2022 report's comparative -- the FY2021 figure does not reconcile with this same report's own Total Assets/Equity/NCI, while 465,844 does; EPS is separately restated 1.50->1.44 for Q4 only). Neither affects this file (Q4 is not included here). NOTABLE FINDING: the same Q4 provisioning-catch-up pattern seen in FY2020 recurs: cumulative net profit fell from 3,717m (9-month) to 1,784m (full year), and cumulative provision for loans jumped from 1,379m (9-month) to 5,413m (full year), a discrete Q4 charge of roughly 4,034m. Flagged in insights.json.
